extracted_papers.method: Adaptive Conformal Inference with dynamically tuned step size (DtACI / online conformal prediction)

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Adaptive conformal residual/quantile score with a gradient-descent miscoverage update; step size is tuned over time.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Provably small regret over all local time intervals of a given width; adapts to arbitrary distribution shifts rather than claiming ordinary exchangeable finite-sample coverage.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: No distributional assumption is required for the baseline predictive algorithm; the method is designed for online data whose distribution varies over time.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Online update with an additional step-size tuning layer; compatible with point or quantile predictors.

extracted_papers.method: Conformal Thresholded Intervals (CTI): density-aware interval thresholding

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Estimated conditional density/probability of each interquantile interval, thresholded by interval length.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Calibration chooses the threshold for marginal coverage; the paper claims the smallest prediction set under a Neyman–Pearson characterization.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Calibration/test exchangeability is the basis for the marginal guarantee (the abstract does not state a time-series relaxation).
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Uses off-the-shelf multi-output quantile regression and avoids estimating the full conditional distribution; described as computationally efficient.

extracted_papers.method: Conformal prediction as inversion of a permutation test for exchangeability; optimal inverse-conditional-density score

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Inverse conditional density of Y given X is identified as the optimal conformal score.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Valid coverage for exchangeable distributions; derives universality/impossibility and optimality results via hypothesis-testing theory.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Exchangeability of the joint n+1 samples is the null being tested/inverted.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: No implementation cost is stated in the abstract; practical cost is score evaluation plus permutation/conformal calibration.

extracted_papers.method: Conformal risk control under non-monotone losses

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Bounded loss evaluated over a finite tuning grid; no monotone score-to-set-size relation is assumed.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: For grid size m and calibration size n, excess risk above target scales as sqrt(log(m)/n), with a matching minimax lower bound; importance-weighted extension covers distribution shift.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Base CRC theory is distribution-free but finite-grid guarantees are stated for calibration data; the paper also treats distribution shift via importance weighting.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Finite grid search; statistical price is sqrt(log(m)/n), so grid resolution and calibration size must be co-designed.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Monotonicity transformations can be unstable/invalid when losses are non-monotone; explicit finite-sample treatment is preferred.

extracted_papers.method: Additive quantile GAM (qgam) with smooth pinball loss and learning-rate calibration

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Smooth generalized pinball loss in additive quantile regression with calibrated learning rate.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Reliable quantile uncertainty estimates are claimed; this is not a conformal finite-sample coverage guarantee.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Not stated; probabilistic loss-based inference for quantile GAMs.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Fast automatic smoothing-parameter estimation and numerical efficiency via stable GAM fitting.

extracted_papers.method: AgACI: expert aggregation over adaptive conformal learning rates for dependent time series

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Adaptive conformal interval score with online ACI learning-rate experts aggregated by AgACI.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Theory analyzes efficiency in exchangeable and autoregressive cases; simulations and electricity-price case study show efficient intervals.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Targets time series/general dependency; explicitly addresses the failure of exchangeability and builds on ACI.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Online expert aggregation over learning rates; code and data are reported as available.

extracted_papers.method: Generalized Venn-Abers / Venn multicalibration for generic losses

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Venn-Abers set-valued calibrated predictor; for quantile loss, Venn multicalibration yields conformal-style intervals.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: At least one marginally calibrated point prediction in finite samples; quantile-loss special cases give group-conditional/multicalibrated coverage.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Finite-sample calibration statements are marginal; conditioning structure is handled through Venn multicalibration, not an explicit time-series assumption.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Set-valued outputs and calibration transforms; exact complexity is not stated in the abstract.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Motivated by limits of histogram binning and isotonic regression, which have only asymptotic guarantees.

extracted_papers.method: Rescaled jackknife+-inspired conformal regression for local coverage

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Rescaled conformal scores using an estimated local score distribution, inspired by Jackknife+.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Formal global coverage guarantees plus an a posteriori local-coverage bound.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Calibration-test exchangeability is explicitly preserved by the construction.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Local score-distribution estimation and Jackknife+-style rescaling; intended to improve low-data intervals.

extracted_papers.method: Non-exchangeable conformal risk control with relevance weights

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Weighted conformal risk score for any monotone loss, with weights encoding relevance to the test point.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Controls expected monotone loss under non-exchangeability; tighter bounds may result from relevance weighting.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Does not require exchangeability; designed for change points, time series, and distribution drift.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Weighted calibration and risk-control search; cost grows with candidate sets and weighting scheme.

extracted_papers.method: Unified comparison of conformal prediction and Wasserstein DRO

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Calibration score quantile: CP inflates quantile level; DRO shifts score quantile in value space using an ambiguity radius.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Both give calibration-conditional coverage with high probability over the calibration sample; DRO additionally certifies uniformly over its ambiguity set.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: CP requires exchangeability; DRO relies on ambiguity-set/distributional properties instead.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: CP uses a closed-form distribution-free level correction; DRO requires choosing/computing a certified radius.
